headline: Lear Corporation Reports Third-Quarter Earnings Beat with Revenue Below Estimates
summary: Lear Corporation posted an earnings per share beat of $0.39, while quarterly revenue fell short of consensus estimates.
why: Automotive supplier earnings indicate production volumes, input cost pressures, and demand trends across major global vehicle manufacturers.

impacts.name: Lear
impacts.why: An earnings beat paired with a revenue miss creates mixed signals for equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A mixed quarterly report featuring an earnings per share beat offset by a revenue shortfall resulted in divergent analyst adjustments.
